name: siyuan-plugins-mcp-sisyphus
description: Let AI control your notes with a SiYuan MCP server that exposes 14 aggregated tools with action-level routing, including document timeline diff and official plugin tool bridging.
author: Taihong Yang

scripts.dev: npm run build:dev:mcp-app && cross-env NODE_ENV=development VITE_SOURCEMAP=inline sh -c 'cross-env BUILD_TARGET=mcp-app vite build --watch & cross-env BUILD_TARGET=renderer vite build --watch & cross-env BUILD_TARGET=server vite build --watch & wait'
scripts.build:dev:mcp-app: cross-env NODE_ENV=development VITE_SOURCEMAP=inline BUILD_TARGET=mcp-app vite build
scripts.build:dev:renderer: cross-env NODE_ENV=development VITE_SOURCEMAP=inline BUILD_TARGET=renderer vite build
scripts.build:dev:server: cross-env NODE_ENV=development VITE_SOURCEMAP=inline BUILD_TARGET=server vite build
scripts.build:dev: npm run build:dev:mcp-app && npm run build:dev:renderer && npm run build:dev:server
scripts.build:server: npm run skills:generate && npm run build:mcp-app && cross-env NODE_ENV=production BUILD_TARGET=server vite build
scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:server
scripts.build:cli: npm run skills:generate && cross-env NODE_ENV=production BUILD_TARGET=cli vite build
scripts.publish:cli: npm run build:cli && cd cli && npm publish --access public
